name: San Juan de Gredos (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper fly, white above and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Juan de Gredos (a crow, mountains, a tree and a river).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 12 April 1999 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 114 of 16 June 1999); the flag is a square flag of proportion 1:1, parted per half in the height, green and white, with the municipal arms in its colours charged at the centre.

features.role: San Juan de Gredos arms — crow, mountains, tree and river
